comment: Enables Google Analytics tracking on the storefront.
modal: When **Yes**, the Google Analytics tracking script is added to storefront pages. Can be configured per website or store view.

comment: The Google Analytics measurement/tracking ID that storefront data is sent to.
modal: The Google Analytics account identifier (tracking/measurement ID) for the storefront. Applies only when **Enable** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether visitor IP addresses are anonymized before being sent to Google Analytics.
modal: When **Yes**, visitor IP addresses are anonymized before being sent to Google Analytics, which helps with privacy compliance. Applies only when **Enable** is Yes.
